bifrost: bifrost_app::view, bifrost_app::widgets, bifrost_ui (stack, constraint, sheet, panels, gesture, ax, screen, cursor, dock_tile), render/appearance
summary: Layout, appearance, animation, gestures, drag and drop are covered. Controls, window/screen API, dock tiles, cursors and accessibility are partial; app-facing sound, speech and haptics are missing.

features.apple: NSView, NSControl, NSButton, NSTextField, NSSlider, NSTableView, NSCollectionView, NSOutlineView
features.note: Core controls, table and collection models exist; many AppKit controls and bezel styles are missing (see docs/bifrost-ui.md).
Split, navigation, scroll and vibrancy exist; no view-controller lifecycle clone.
Stack views and a Cassowary constraint solver cover the main layout features.

features.apple: NSAppearance, Dark Mode, accent colour, NSColor named colours
features.note: Light, Dark and Auto with cross-fade, named adaptive colours; external apps follow it via portal.
Implicit animation with curves and springs; window animation behaviours implemented.

features.apple: NSWindow, NSPanel, NSScreen, sheets, open/save panels, font and colour panels
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/sheet.rs; springboard/ui/src/panels.rs; springboard/ui/src/screen.rs; springboard/src/shell/docpanel.rs; springboard/src/shell/desk.rs; springboard/wm
features.note: Windows, sheets, open/save and font/colour panels exist. springboard/ui/src/screen.rs models NSScreen geometry (frame, visible frame, backing conversion, main, deepest, containing lookups); the SDK does not yet receive display data from the shell.
Audio service exists in the system layer; no app-facing sound, speech or haptic API found.
Needs iPhone and Apple Continuity; local camera support exists in the shell.
Responder chain, shortcuts and focus exist; event monitors and full text-input client are partial.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/menu.rs; springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs; springboard/ui/src/dock_tile.rs; springboard/sdk/src/status_item.rs; springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs (set_badge); springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs; springboard/src/shell/desktop_dock.rs
features.note: Menus and status items exist. springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs models the cursor stack (push, pop, set, hide/unhide counts) and springboard/ui/src/dock_tile.rs models the badge label, four-character display limit, app-icon badge flag and redraw requests. Cursor images with hot spots and Dock tile menus are missing; the shell does not yet draw cursor shapes from the stack.
Gesture recognizers model plus shell trackpad gestures.
Touch Bar hardware is Apple-only; no counterpart planned.
DnD and pasteboard APIs for apps.
Accessibility tree bridged over AT-SPI with text, announcements; no full role/rotor coverage.

gaps: App-facing sound, speech synthesis and haptics API
SDK wiring of screens: the shell does not report displays to apps (springboard/ui/src/screen.rs is the model only)
Cursor images with hot spots, drawn by the shell from the cursor stack
Dock tile menus and drawing of the app-icon badge
Missing control types and bezel styles
